problem: Solder joint cold solder defects increase on PCB assembly line during rainy season.
cause: Relative humidity >70% in soldering zone causing flux moisture absorption. Flux activity reduced, leading to poor wetting.
solution: Set assembly zone humidity to 45–55% RH (install dehumidifier). Switch to no-clean flux with higher moisture tolerance (activation temperature range wider). Pre-bake PCBs at 80°C for 2 hours if stored >48 hours.
expert_note: Nguồn: SMT process engineer, seasonal defect pattern analysis

problem: Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) produces inconsistent repeat measurements (σ = 0.008mm, should be <0.002mm).

problem: Servo drive (Mitsubishi MR-J4) triggers alarm AL.032 (overcurrent) randomly during acceleration.
cause: Motor cable insulation degraded at bend point where cable passes through cabinet opening. Intermittent ground fault during high-current acceleration phase.
solution: Inspect full cable run — look for abrasion at conduit edges and sharp bends. Replace cable with minimum bend radius compliance (cable OD × 10). Add cable protection sleeve at cabinet entry. Re-route cable to eliminate tight bend. Check insulation resistance before restart (>1MΩ at 500V DC).

problem: Worker reports numbness in fingers after 4 hours of using pneumatic screwdriver.

solution: Rotate operator every 2 hours. Provide anti-vibration gloves (ISO 10819 rated). Evaluate low-vibration alternative tool (target <4 m/s²). Track cumulative daily exposure for each operator. Refer to occupational health for baseline medical exam.

problem: Scrap rate on turning operation spikes to 4.2% every Monday morning (1st shift).
cause: CNC program uses thermal compensation values from Friday — machine is cold on Monday morning but program assumes warm operating state. Diameter cut 0.03–0.04mm smaller than nominal.
solution: Add Monday morning warm-up macro to CNC program (run 3 cycles of dry-run cutting at 50% feed before production). Or: measure first piece and apply automatic offset correction before production run. Log temperature at spindle nose on startup.
